notes: SpringGreen 2026 FDD Item 19 contains three tables: Table A (cost/margin percentages for 62 franchised businesses open 1+ full year), Table B (annual gross sales for 72 franchised businesses open 1+ full year), and Table C (marketing investment, new services revenue, and customer retention for 65 of 72 businesses participating in approved marketing campaigns, plus a single-territory subset of 35). All values extracted directly from disclosed tables. Cohort mapping note: the '1+ full year' cohort is technically open_12_plus_mo but mapped to open_12_24mo as the closest schema option — this is a minimum-tenure cohort not capped at 24 months. The single-territory vs. multiple-territory split in Tables B and C is mapped to ownership_group_anchored as it groups by territory count. The 'per vehicle' metric in Table B is flagged as market-area scope since it is a sub-franchisee-level metric. Percentage fields (Table A margin metrics, Table C marketing %, retention) have unit_period=null per schema guidance.
